Prominent.description:
✅ Use for primary actions or elements that need to stand out. 
❌ Avoid using for secondary or less important actions.

Primary.description:
✅ Use for primary actions (e.g., "Submit", "Save"). Use in exceptional cases to highlight an interactive part of complex components (e.g. handle of slider)  
❌ Do not use for secondary or tertiary actions.

Secondary.description:
✅ Use for secondary actions. 
❌ Avoid using for primary or destructive actions.

Tertiary.description:
✅ Use for tertiary actions (actions that are optional, infrequent, or supplementary). Also apply on Navigation items. 
❌ Avoid using for primary or secondary actions.

Canvas.description:
✅ Use for full-page backgrounds, section backgrounds and backgrounds of  elevated elements.
❌ Avoid using for individual components which are not elevated.

Scrim.description:
✅ Apply as an overlay to dim the background when modals or sheets are open. 
❌ Do not use for component fills or interactive elements.

Group.description:
✅ Use for grouping related content or components. 
❌ Avoid using for individual buttons or standalone elements.

Container.description:
✅ Use for secondary non interactive surfaces. 
❌ Do not use for interactive buttons.

Input.description:
✅ Use for form controls and input fields. 
❌ Avoid using for buttons or high-visibility elements.

Transparent.description:
✅ Use when a component needs to be visually transparent (in certain states). 
❌ Do not use for solid backgrounds or opaque elements.

Skeleton.description:
✅ Use for skeleton screens. 
❌ Do not use for interactive elements.

Strong.description:
✅ Use for selected states of buttons and form controls. 
❌ Avoid using for navigation items and unselected states.

Subtle.description:
✅ Use to highlight selections subtly. Typically used on spacious components. 
❌ Avoid using for buttons or controls.

Positive.description:
✅ Use to signal positive status. Combine with "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Advisory.description:
✅ Use to signal advisory status. Combine with "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Warning.description:
✅ Use to signal warning status. Combine with "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Informative.description:
✅ Use to signal informative status. Combine with "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Neutral.description:
✅ Use to signal neutral status. Combine with "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Critical.description:
✅ Use to signal critical status. Combine with "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Transparent.description:
✅ Use for component strokes that are transparent in required states. 
❌ Avoid using on stateless components (in these cases no token needs to be applied).

Prominent.description:
✅ Use for components that need to stand out. 
❌ Avoid combining with other fill than "Prominent".

Critical.description:
✅ Use as stroke on components to indicate error state or on destructive components. 
❌ Avoid using for content or fills. Avoid using as decorative color.

Focus.description:
✅ Use for strokes to highlight components which received focus state. Combine with  "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" 
❌ Avoid using for content or fills. Avoid using as decorative color.

Positive.description:
✅ Use as stroke on components to indicate success state or on encouraging components. 
❌ Avoid using for content or fills. Avoid using as decorative color.

Bold.description:
✅ Bold Stroke assures contrast against all backgounds. 
Use on interactive, components in idle and disabled states. 
Use to assure contrast of non interactive shapes, if required. 
❌ Avoid combining with "Prominent" or "Destructive" fill. Avoid using on components in selected state.

Strong.description:
✅ Use for pressed state if idle states stroke is "Bold" or "Medium". 
Can also be use as fallback solution to indicate selected state. 
❌ Avoid using on non interactive components. Avoid on idle, disabled staes of unselected components.

Medium.description:
✅ Use for interactive components with low priority on idle and disabled states. 
❌ Avoid if stroke color needs to meet A11Y contrast requirements.

Subtle.description:
✅ Use for dividers. 
❌ Avoid using for interactive or prominent elements.

MediumInverted.description:
✅ Use to ensure contrast of colored shapes on "inverted" surfaces (eg: Graph Color on Fill.Selected.Strong)
❌ Avoid using for elements placed on canvas or group.

Hover.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate hover state. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Secondary.Strong 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Tertiary 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Quaternary 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Group  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Pressed.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate pressed state. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Secondary.Strong 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Tertiary 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Quaternary 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Group  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Hover.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate hover state of interactive components. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Selected.Subtle  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Pressed.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate pressed state of interactive components. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Selected.Subtle  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Hover.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate hover state of interactive components. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Selected.Strong 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Prominent 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Destructive 
Use also to overlay interactive components with image background.  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Pressed.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate pressed state of interactive components. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Selected.Strong 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Prominent 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Destructive 
Use also to overlay interactive components with image background. 
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Hover.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate hover state of interactive components. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Primary  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Pressed.description:
✅ Overlays fill color to indicate pressed state of interactive components. Can be combined with: 
- Sem.Color.Fill.Primary  
❌ Avoid using as Fill, Stroke or Content Color

Primary.description:
✅ Use for primary content of components (Labels, UserInput, Icons). 
❌ Avoid using for , Copy Text, Headlines or secondary content (Descriptions, Units, Appendix).

Secondary.description:
✅ Use for Headlines (and Display). 
❌ Avoid using elsewhere than on Headlines.

Tertiary.description:
✅ Use for links, copy text and secondary content (Icon, Description, Placeholder, Units, Appendix, Message, Range, TrainLine) 
❌ Avoid using on component parts which the user interacts with.

Quaternary.description:
✅ Use for low priority elements of components. 
❌ Avoid using on text.

Transparent.description:
✅ Use for content that is transparent in required states. 
❌ Avoid using on stateless components (in these cases no token needs to be applied).

PrimaryStatic.description:
✅ Use for primary content placed on "static" surfaces (similar lightness on dark and light themes) e.g: on "Fill.Prominent".
❌ Avoid using on content placed on non static content

PrimaryInverted.description:
✅ Use for primary content of inverterted components. 
❌ Never apply on non inverted components.

Neutral.description: ✅ Use for primary content placed on "Signal.Neutral".

Informative.description: ✅ Use for primary content placed on "Signal.Informative".

Positive.description: ✅ Use for primary content placed on "Signal.Success".

Advisory.description: ✅ Use for primary content placed on "Signal.Advisory".

Warning.description: ✅ Use for primary content placed on "Signal.Warning".

Critical.description: ✅ Use for primary content placed on "Signal.Critical".

Positive.description:
✅ Use for content to signal positive status. 
❌ Avoid using for fills or stokes.

Advisory.description:
✅ Use for fill to signal pending or advisory status. Combine with  "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Warning.description:
✅ Use for fill to signal warning status. Combine with  "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Informative.description:
✅ Use for fill to signal informative status. Combine with  "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Neutral.description:
✅ Use for fill to signal neutral status. Combine with  "Sem.Color.Stoke.Bold" if you need to assure contrast against background. 
❌ Avoid using for content.

Critical.description:
✅ Use for content to signal negative status. 
❌ Avoid using for fills or stokes.

SecondaryInverted.description:
✅ Use for secondary content of inverterted components. 
❌ Never apply on non inverted components.

TertiaryInverted.description:
✅ Use for tertiary content of inverterted components. 
❌ Never apply on non inverted components.

QuaternaryInverted.description:
✅ Use for low priority elements of inverterted components. 
❌ Never apply on non inverted components. Avoid using for text.

Cold.description:
✅ Use for fills or strokes on UI which configures or displays temperature settings (e.g. air condition, seat heating).  
❌ Avoid using for content.

Hot.description:
✅ Use for fills or strokes on UI which configures or displays temperature settings (e.g. air condition, seat heating).  
❌ Avoid using for content.

Charging.description:
✅ Use for fills or strokes on UI which configures or displays charging settings or status.  
❌ Avoid using for content.

Disabled.description: ✅ Use to reduce opacity of disabled components.

CurrentThemeIsLight.description:
This is a boolean variable to switch things on if the current theme is "Light".  The value is:
- "true" if current theme is "Light"
- "false" if current theme is "Dark"

CurrentThemeIsDark.description:
This is a boolean variable to switch things on if the current theme is "Dark".  The value is:
- "false" if current theme is "Light"
- "true" if current theme is "Dark"
